name: metis-context-ledger
description: Maintain and export a compact filesystem-first context workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Keep durable context compact and portable.
interface.longDescription: Maintain a session-independent context workspace in place and export it as a Claude-memory-compatible folder for another host or orchestrator.
defaultPrompt: Organize the current context into the Metis ledger.
Export the current context for another host.
